text: The inspected offline-body caller checks that the progress string index is empty or the message-progress index, immediately before the modified batch call. Its MOZ_ASSERT has only the condition and no message; the nearby comment is not a diagnostic argument. This existing assertion should describe its expected progress mode. No failure was triggered and no unrelated assertion is changed.
title: The IMAP body-batch caller has no message on its progress-mode assertion
